comments.body:
Enjoy your free time! If you follow the courses through the semester, it‘s enough. Most things are discussed like you have no knowledge in this field like analysis or lin. algebra. In  other fields, everyone starts from zero. 
It has to be mentioned, that this was the case 6.5 years ago, when I enrolled in mechanical engineering. Although the curriculum has changed recently, it won‘t be much difference. Regarding the passing of semesters: focus on the the courses which contributes the most to the passing grade.
comments.author: Moefeee
